result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues make the food delivery home screen look broken: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and the bottom nav is missing an icon for Orders.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with no ellipsis or full-name treatment in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce font size slightly, or use ellipsis and ensure cards have consistent width so names are fully readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow horizontally; the last chip is clipped and there is no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with padding/fade or a peek of the next chip, and ensure the last visible chip is not cut mid-control.

issues.description: Bottom navigation 'Orders' tab shows a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g. receipt/bag) and align icon+label styling with the other tabs.

issues.description: Bottom of the pizza promo card is clipped by the tab bar, so the image and heart control feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so cards are not obscured when scrolling stops.

issues.description: Notification bell shows a red dot with no visible count or clear unread state context.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the badge is intentional and accessible (e.g. count or aria label); otherwise remove the empty indicator.
